reading: France is on high alert ahead of a new wave of nationwide marches, just a week after experiencing some of its most severe turmoil in decades.
Although authorities have imposed sweeping bans on demonstrations, hundreds of thousands of participants are still expected to converge on Paris and other major cities.
Facing accusations of failing to foresee the extent of the earlier disorder, the government is drastically ramping up security by dispatching 70,000 personnel.
The interior minister warned that security forces would be uncompromising with violent offenders, citing numerous online calls for violence from radical factions.
The initial movement was ignited by high school students demanding better educational environments and urgent solutions to staff shortages.
Although the French president recently met with student representatives and pledged clear commitments to them, these delegates have urged their peers to continue to mobilise.
Several key municipalities have taken an aggressive regulatory stance by announcing blanket bans on all public gatherings ahead of the weekend.
In Paris, a march supported by labour groups has been officially ordered to adhere to a route that entirely bypasses the city centre.
Nevertheless, prominent cultural institutions in the capital have opted to close pre-emptively as businesses board up their windows to mitigate potential damage.
What began as a student-led initiative has rapidly expanded to become a wider anti-government outpouring across the nation.
Meanwhile, the national government has promised to reconstruct a severely damaged civic building entirely, ensuring that local taxpayers will not have to foot the bill.

vocabulary.definition: A state of great disturbance, confusion, or uncertainty.
Extensive or wide-ranging in scope, effect, or application.
To move towards a specific location from different directions and gather there.
To be aware of beforehand; to predict or anticipate an event.
Substantially increasing the level, amount, or speed of an activity or effort.
Showing an unwillingness to make concessions or negotiate, particularly when enforcing rules.
Sparked or started a heated situation, such as an argument, movement, or conflict.
Absolute prohibitions that apply universally to all cases or situations without exception.
Done beforehand to prevent an anticipated event or to mitigate its effects.
A sudden, robust expression of strong emotion or widespread public dissent.
To pay for something, especially a large or unexpected expense.

entries.ja: 大きな騒動、混乱、または不確実な状態。
entries.ko: 큰 소란, 혼란 또는 불확실한 상태.
entries.zh-Hans: 一种高度混乱、困惑或不确定的状态。
entries.es: Un estado de gran perturbación, confusión o incertidumbre.
entries.pt-BR: Um estado de grande perturbação, confusão ou incerteza.
entries.fr: Un état de grand trouble, de confusion ou d'incertitude.
entries.de: Ein Zustand großer Unruhe, Verwirrung oder Ungewissheit.

entries.ja: 範囲、影響、または適用において広範囲にわたる、または大規模なこと。
entries.ko: 범위, 영향 또는 적용에 있어 광범위하거나 대규모인 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 范围、影响或应用广泛的。
entries.es: Extenso o de amplio alcance en su ámbito, efecto o aplicación.
entries.pt-BR: Amplo ou de grande alcance em sua extensão, efeito ou aplicação.
entries.fr: Étendu ou de grande portée dans son ampleur, son effet ou son application.
entries.de: Weitreichend oder umfassend in Bezug auf Umfang, Wirkung oder Anwendung.

entries.ja: 異なる方向から特定の場所に移動し、そこに集まること。
entries.ko: 여러 방향에서 특정 장소로 이동하여 그곳에 모이는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 从不同方向向特定地点移动并在那里聚集。
entries.es: Moverse hacia un lugar específico desde diferentes direcciones y reunirse allí.
entries.pt-BR: Mover-se em direção a um local específico de diferentes direções e reunir-se lá.
entries.fr: Se déplacer vers un lieu spécifique depuis différentes directions et s'y rassembler.
entries.de: Sich aus verschiedenen Richtungen auf einen bestimmten Ort zubewegen und sich dort versammeln.

entries.ja: 事前に知ること。ある出来事を予測したり、予期したりすること。
entries.ko: 미리 알다. 어떤 사건을 예측하거나 예상하다.
entries.zh-Hans: 事先知道；预测或预料某个事件。
entries.es: Estar al tanto de antemano; predecir o anticipar un evento.
entries.pt-BR: Estar ciente de antemão; prever ou antecipar um evento.
entries.fr: Être conscient à l'avance; prédire ou anticiper un événement.
entries.de: Im Voraus wissen; ein Ereignis vorhersagen oder erwarten.

entries.ja: 活動や努力のレベル、量、または速度を大幅に上げること。
entries.ko: 활동이나 노력의 수준, 양 또는 속도를 상당히 증가시키는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 大幅提高某项活动或努力的水平、数量或速度。
entries.es: Aumentar sustancialmente el nivel, la cantidad o la velocidad de una actividad o esfuerzo.
entries.pt-BR: Aumentar substancialmente o nível, a quantidade ou a velocidade de uma atividade ou esforço.
entries.fr: Augmenter substantiellement le niveau, la quantité ou la vitesse d'une activité ou d'un effort.
entries.de: Das Niveau, die Menge oder die Geschwindigkeit einer Aktivität oder Anstrengung erheblich steigern.

entries.ja: 特に規則を施行する際に、譲歩したり交渉したりする意思がないことを示すこと。
entries.ko: 특히 규칙을 시행할 때, 양보하거나 협상할 의지가 없음을 보여주는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 表示不愿意妥协或谈判，尤其是在执行规则时。
entries.es: Mostrar falta de disposición para hacer concesiones o negociar, particularmente al hacer cumplir las reglas.
entries.pt-BR: Mostrar indisposição para fazer concessões ou negociar, particularmente ao aplicar regras.
entries.fr: Faire preuve d'une réticence à faire des concessions ou à négocier, en particulier lors de l'application de règles.
entries.de: Eine Unwilligkeit zeigen, Zugeständnisse zu machen oder zu verhandeln, besonders bei der Durchsetzung von Regeln.

entries.ja: 議論、運動、紛争などの激しい状況に火をつけたり、それを開始したりした状態。
entries.ko: 논쟁, 운동 또는 갈등과 같은 격렬한 상황을 촉발하거나 시작한.
entries.zh-Hans: 引发或启动一个激烈的情形，例如争论、运动或冲突。
entries.es: Provocar o iniciar una situación acalorada, como una discusión, un movimiento o un conflicto.
entries.pt-BR: Provocar ou iniciar uma situação acalorada, como uma discussão, um movimento ou um conflito.
entries.fr: Déclencher ou démarrer une situation animée, telle qu'une dispute, un mouvement ou un conflit.
entries.de: Eine hitzige Situation, wie einen Streit, eine Bewegung oder einen Konflikt, ausgelöst oder in Gang gesetzt.

entries.ja: 例外なく、すべてのケースまたは状況に普遍的に適用される絶対的な禁止。
entries.ko: 예외 없이 모든 경우 또는 상황에 보편적으로 적용되는 절대적인 금지.
entries.zh-Hans: 普遍适用于所有情况或局面，无一例外，完全禁止。
entries.es: Prohibiciones absolutas que se aplican universalmente a todos los casos o situaciones sin excepción.
entries.pt-BR: Proibições absolutas que se aplicam universalmente a todos os casos ou situações sem exceção.
entries.fr: Interdictions absolues qui s'appliquent universellement à tous les cas ou situations sans exception.
entries.de: Absolute Verbote, die ausnahmslos universell für alle Fälle oder Situationen gelten.

entries.ja: 予想される出来事を防ぐため、またはその影響を軽減するために事前に行われること。
entries.ko: 예상되는 사건을 방지하거나 그 영향을 완화하기 위해 미리 하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 为防止预期的事件或减轻其影响而预先采取的行动。
entries.es: Realizado de antemano para prevenir un evento anticipado o para mitigar sus efectos.
entries.pt-BR: Feito antecipadamente para prevenir um evento esperado ou para mitigar seus efeitos.
entries.fr: Fait à l'avance pour prévenir un événement anticipé ou pour en atténuer les effets.
entries.de: Im Voraus geschehen, um ein erwartetes Ereignis zu verhindern oder dessen Auswirkungen zu mindern.

entries.ja: 強い感情や広範な公共の不満が突然、力強く表明されること。
entries.ko: 강한 감정이나 광범위한 대중의 반대가 갑자기 강력하게 표출되는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 对强烈情感或普遍公众异议的突然而有力的表达。
entries.es: Una expresión súbita y robusta de una emoción fuerte o de una disidencia pública generalizada.
entries.pt-BR: Uma expressão súbita e robusta de forte emoção ou de uma dissidência pública generalizada.
entries.fr: Une expression soudaine et robuste d'une émotion forte ou d'un large désaccord public.
entries.de: Ein plötzlicher, kräftiger Ausdruck starker Emotionen oder weitverbreiteter öffentlicher Meinungsverschiedenheiten.

entries.ja: 特に高額な、または予期せぬ費用を支払うこと。
entries.ko: 특히 크거나 예상치 못한 비용을 지불하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 支付某物的费用，特别是大笔或意想不到的开支。
entries.es: Pagar por algo, especialmente un gasto grande o inesperado.
entries.pt-BR: Pagar por algo, especialmente uma despesa grande ou inesperada.
entries.fr: Payer pour quelque chose, en particulier une dépense importante ou inattendue.
entries.de: Für etwas bezahlen, insbesondere eine große oder unerwartete Ausgabe.
